title: pi-jsonl 1 entry
description: One line of a Pi session file, the `raw` column of the entry and message tables. Partial: the fields listed are the common and useful ones; a line carries more. The first line is the header, type `session`; every later line is an entry. Measured on Pi 1.5.2, November 2026, with the shapes of format versions 1 and 2 that Pi still reads. Read a value with json_extract(raw, '$.path') after scoping rows to content_format 'pi-jsonl 1'.

type.description: The entry kind, the entry table's type column: session (the header), message, model_change, thinking_level_change, usage, compaction, branch_summary, custom, custom_message, context_edit, label, session_info. An extension or a later Pi can write others.

id.description: On an entry: its id, the entry table's uuid column; usually 8 hex characters. Absent on entries of format version 1. On the header: the session id

parentId.description: The id of the entry this one follows; null on a root. One file holds every branch of a session, so two entries can share a parent. Absent on entries of format version 1, which follow one another in file order

timestamp.description: RFC 3339; the entry table's timestamp column

version.description: On the header: the format version, 2 or 3. Absent on a version 1 header

cwd.description: On the header: the working directory the session started in, which the session table's project column is the slug of

parentSession.description: On the header of a fork: the path of the session file it was forked from. A fork repeats its parent's entries

message.description: On a message entry. The role is the entry table's subtype column.

role.description: user, assistant, toolResult, system, bashExecution (a shell command the user ran from Pi), or custom (an extension's message; hookMessage before format version 3)

content.description: A string, or content blocks. One assistant response is one entry holding all of its blocks

model.description: On an assistant message: the model asked. The session table's model column takes the first

responseModel.description: The model the provider reports as having answered

stopReason.description: On an assistant message: stop, length, toolUse, error, aborted, or deferred

toolCallId.description: On a toolResult message: the id of the toolCall block it answers

details.description: On a toolResult message: what the tool recorded beside its content, in the tool's own shape

sections.description: On a system message: prompt sections by name. A string sets the section, null removes it; replaying the system messages in order gives the current prompt

toolsAdded.description: On a system message: tool declarations added, each {name, description, parameters}

toolsRemoved.description: On a system message: tools removed, each {name}

customType.description: On a custom message: the extension's name for it

modelId.description: On a model_change entry: the model selected

thinkingLevel.description: On a thinking_level_change entry: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh

kind.description: On a usage entry: what the request was for, such as cache_warm; the entry table's subtype column

summary.description: On compaction and branch_summary entries: the summary text, which is the message table's text

firstKeptEntryId.description: On a compaction entry: the first earlier entry the model still sees. Format version 1 has firstKeptEntryIndex, a line index with the header at 0

systemMessage.description: On a compaction entry: the whole prompt and tool set at the compaction, as one system message

fromId.description: On a branch_summary entry: the leaf of the branch that was left

customType.description: On custom and custom_message entries: the extension's name for the entry; the entry table's subtype column

data.description: On a custom entry: the extension's state

content.description: On a custom_message entry: a string or content blocks, sent to the model as a user message

targetId.description: On label and context_edit entries: the entry labelled or edited

label.description: On a label entry; absent when the label is cleared

replacement.description: On a context_edit entry: {content} the model sees in place of the target's, or null when the target is left out

name.description: On a session_info entry: the session's name, which is the session table's title when set

thinking.description: On a thinking block; empty when the provider returned it encrypted

id.description: On a toolCall block: the call id, the tool_use table's id column

name.description: On a toolCall block: the tool

arguments.description: On a toolCall block: the value of the tool_use table's input_raw column

usage.description: The tokens and cost of one model request. On an assistant message, a toolResult message whose tool ran a model, a usage entry, and a compaction or branch_summary entry. Each request is written once; the session table's totals sum them over every branch.

input.description: Prompt tokens neither read from nor written to a cache

cost.description: US dollars, Pi's estimate from the model's listed prices
